title: AutoTriager proposed runtime contract
description: Author: Dahe Chen. Runtime-design schema, not an implemented service, spending authorization, diagnosis result or validation of real source provenance. Real identities are supported; companion examples are synthetic.

ToolReply.description: Private read-only gateway materialization; not a browser HTTP route. Contains actual admitted records, not just evidence IDs. Entire serialized payload is scoped, persisted and charged before return.
